parameters.name: FunctionBlockId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the custom TSL module, which is unique within the product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default module data is queried.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ModelVersion
parameters.description:
The version number of the TSL model to query.
Call [ListThingModelVersion](~~150318~~) to view the TSL model version numbers of a product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the TSL model feature definitions in draft status are queried. If you specify this parameter, the TSL model feature definitions of the specified version are queried.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID.

><notice>IoT Platform currently supports resource group management only at the instance level. The **ResourceGroupId** request parameter is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
></notice>
